recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. Any future correction to the manufacturing-batch extension, including possible R6-era context alignment with Medication.instance, should be handled in HL7/fhir-extensions or by work-group review.
issue_request: FHIR-29574 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested a CodeableConcept closure-type attribute for Medication.batch; the accepted resolution was to create a core extension for the attribute.
initial_application: Commit 52f3ef3d50 added the manufacturing-batch extension source in core, including manufacturingBatch.container.closureType as a CodeableConcept. The generated StructureDefinition was present before commit dd468d4f17, which intentionally removed extension definitions from R5 core source, including medication-manufacturingBatch and its Medication-core IG reference.
additional_context: Current core source actively builds Medication but contains medication-manufacturingBatch only as a canonical OID. The FHIR Extension Pack source and CI build now define and publish the medication-manufacturingBatch extension with the requested closureType slice. Pharmacy 2020-11-09 minutes support the extension approach, and later FHIR-47622 work renamed Medication.batch to Medication.instance in core for R6 but is already separately reconciled on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No HL7/fhir source change was made because re-adding the extension definition to core would reverse the later source split that moved extension definitions to HL7/fhir-extensions.
